mapper.sql: select id, attendee_id, phone, port_no, checkin_date, checkin_time, create_time from kcon_checkin
mapper.insert: insert into kcon_checkin (attendee_id, phone, port_no, checkin_date, checkin_time, create_time) values (#{attendeeId}, #{phone}, #{portNo}, #{checkinDate}, #{checkinTime}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from kcon_checkin where checkin_date = curdate()

select count(*) from kcon_checkin where attendee_id in
#{id}

select c.id, c.attendee_id, c.phone, c.port_no, c.checkin_date, c.checkin_time, c.create_time, a.channel, a.ticket_type, a.draw_eligible from kcon_checkin c join kcon_attendee a on a.id = c.attendee_id where c.checkin_date = curdate() order by c.checkin_time asc, c.id asc

select a.name as `姓名`, a.phone as `手机号`, a.channel as `渠道标识`, a.ticket_type as `票种`, case when a.draw_eligible = 1 then '是' else '否' end as `是否参与抽奖`, a.company as `公司`, a.email as `邮箱`, a.position as `职务/年级`, c.port_no as `端口号`, date_format(c.checkin_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `签到时间`, case when g.id is null then '未发放' else '已发放' end as `权益发放`, date_format(g.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `权益发放时间`, case when w.id is null then '否' else '是' end as `是否中奖`, w.tier_name as `奖项`, case when w.id is null then '' when w.status = 0 then '未领取' when w.status = 1 then '已领取' when w.status = 2 then '已作废' else '' end as `是否已领取` from kcon_attendee a left join kcon_checkin c on c.attendee_id = a.id left join kcon_benefit_grant g on g.attendee_id = a.id and g.grant_type = 'BENEFIT' left join kcon_winner w on w.port_no = c.port_no and w.status != 2 order by a.id
